notes: Candidates are the bacteria-alone controls of a dual RNA-seq infection study: LF82 1 h and 6 h in DMEM (static, 37 °C, 5% CO2) and LF82 'in stationary' (medium and temperature not given). Treated as plain growth controls (treatment none); whether DMEM was a shift from the stationary culture is not stated. DMEM serum content not stated, medium_class left out. rRNA depletion text mentions human rRNAs.
